import sqlite3
import json

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')

sql_reserves = "SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30'"
cur.execute(sql_reserves)
print("jun30_reserves_usd:", cur.fetchone()[0])

sql_recon = """
SELECT
  (SELECT reported_reserve_usd FROM reported_balances WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30') -
  (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30')
"""
cur.execute(sql_recon)
print("jun30_reconciliation_usd:", cur.fetchone()[0])

sql_cov = """
SELECT
  ((SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 1.0 FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30') /
   (SELECT circulating_rlusd * 1.0 FROM reported_balances WHERE report_date = '2025-06-30') -
   (SELECT SUM(amount_usd) * 1.0 FROM reserve_components WHERE report_date = '2025-05-30') /
   (SELECT circulating_rlusd * 1.0 FROM reported_balances WHERE report_date = '2025-05-30')
  ) * 10000.0
"""
cur.execute(sql_cov)
print("coverage_change_bps:", cur.fetchone()[0])

EOF
